summary: Alps Group Inc, a Malaysian-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on the US market, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held October 30, 2026, virtually. On the October 5 record date, 158,400,314 ordinary shares were entitled to vote; 116,891,039 shares (73.79%) were represented. Shareholders approved a five-for-one share consolidation (ordinary and preferred), a related capital increase to US$105,000 across 210,000,000 shares, and adoption of amended articles, each with roughly 99.99% support. This is a routine EGM outcome, not a special situation. Watch for post-consolidation listing mechanics and any subsequent capital raise.
